values.name: Ship partial - balance back order
values.description: Partial shipping is allowed. The rest of the order should be delivered as soon as possible.

values.name: Cancel if not delivered by date
values.description: An order or the rest of an order should be cancelled if not delivered at specified date.

values.name: Deliver on date
values.description: An order should be delivered exactly on specified date.

values.name: Substitute item
values.description: A substitute item may be delivered, if the ordered item is not available.

values.name: Ship as soon as possible
values.description: The order should be delivered as soon as possible.

values.name: Ship complete order
values.description: The order should be delivered only complete, not partial.

values.name: Ship partial, if no freight rate increase
values.description: Partial shipping of an order is allowed, if the total freight rate do not increase.

values.name: Ship partial - balance cancel
values.description: Partial shipping is allowed. The rest of the order should be cancelled.
